integrity: The infinite-dimensional theorem is proved by Fourier analysis. Finite checker results only test finite sections; they are not exhaustive or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Standard complex ℓ² unilateral shift plus the specified coordinate conjugation, real parameter a>0. No extension to arbitrary real-linear or weighted shifts. Priority over all earlier mixed Toeplitz results is not independently verified.
title: Exact numerical-range support of a shift plus coordinate conjugation
